product_one_liner.value: SurveySparrow is an AI-powered customer and employee experience feedback platform that lets organizations create and distribute surveys, collect feedback, and turn responses into actionable insights.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes an AI-powered customer experience platform and its feedback analysis tools.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing page lists plan tiers including Free, Basic, Starter, Business, and Enterprise.

named_customers.notes: Names shown among published customer stories.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn company profile states company size of 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: Company address is in San Francisco, California, United States.

founded_year.notes: Company announcement states it was founded in October 2017.

eng_blog.notes: Dedicated engineering blog; indexed posts include an event-driven microservices architecture article and a developer SDK/AppNest build article, both published in 2024.

public_docs.notes: Homepage footer links to a public Help Center containing product documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Could not verify an official current careers page or live job board and therefore cannot establish the current status.

model_provider.notes: The security page names AWS as hosting provider but does not identify the AI model or model provider. Search of company AI content yielded no verified provider statement.

compliance_certs.notes: The security page explicitly names SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001:2022, HIPAA, and GDPR.

last_funding.notes: Most recent located round is the $1.4 million seed round announced April 2, 2019. A dubious report claimed a later $50 million round, but credible company and funding records located support the 2019 seed as the documented round.

raised_18mo.notes: The documented latest round was announced in April 2019, before the 18-month window beginning 2025-05-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: No current official careers/job-board page was found to establish open hiring status.

launched_6mo.notes: The latest launch-type result found was the AI Survey feature from 2026-04-25, outside the six-month window that began 2026-05-09; newer indexed blog items located were informational content, not launches.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The company about page identifies the founder and CEO but provides no sufficiently complete leadership history or dated join/departure evidence for the relevant period.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Both Salesforce and HubSpot appear as explicit integration systems.
